concept: Make intelligence visible as a web: many distinct filaments cross with deliberate purpose and resolve into one lucid structure. The image evokes Moriarty’s mathematical mind and Victorian intrigue through the tension between order and shadow. The Web is the subject; no character represents it.
composition: Use a square-friendly portrait field, centered so a mobile crop keeps the complete central form. Let the web fill most of the image, with quiet charcoal around its outer arcs and a woven convergence near center. Preserve balanced weight and subtle depth; avoid one oversized emblem.
strands: Draw numerous hair-thin ivory and antique-gold strands. Keep their separate paths legible at the edges, then interlace them into one coherent web. Vary brightness and tension rather than thickness. A few restrained junction glints are acceptable, never glowing nodes. Suggest a crescent and four-point star through the geometry.
brandConnection: Use Moriarty’s charcoal, warm ivory, muted antique gold, refined serif sensibility, and measured celestial geometry. Convey Victorian intrigue through precise, engraved detail and hidden order, not literal setting. Match the restrained dark hero while giving the Web an identity beyond portraiture.
avoid: No people, faces, silhouettes, costume, detective props, skyline, gears, circuitry, blockchain globe, neon, floating dots, text, or lettering. Avoid proof-count symbols, a seven-part pipeline, diagram steps, and self-executing contract imagery. Keep the web distinct from tangled chaos and decorative lace.
imagePrompt: Create a restrained editorial hero illustration for Moriarty Webs and Strands, without text. Portrait 4:5, also legible as a square crop. On charcoal, show individually legible hair-fine ivory and antique-gold filaments crossing with mathematical purpose and weaving into one coherent web at center. Use delicate engraved linework, subtle depth, quiet negative space, and a crescent-star shape implied by the strands. Intelligent, patient, mysterious mood; low luminosity and mobile-safe composition. No people, detective objects, city, circuitry, neon, glowing node network, or lettering.
